claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows chipped paint on the machine head, so it is not cosmetically perfect.

risks.risk: Whether the machine sews or turns over.
risks.proof: A video of the balance wheel being turned by hand and the needle moving, or a clip of it stitching fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / for parts only.

risks.risk: Condition of the belt and internal mechanics.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the belt and open underside mechanics, or a video of operation.

risks.risk: Included accessories like bobbins or needles.
risks.proof: A photo showing all accessories included with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only, with no accessories.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number plate or any date marking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified age / vintage without documentation.

proof_requests: Video of the machine turning over and stitching
Close-up of the serial number plate
Photo of any included bobbins, needles, or accessories
response.reason: The witness identifies a Singer treadle sewing machine with visible chipped paint, contradicting the seller's perfect-condition claim; it can be priced at its worst case pending proof of function, mechanics, accessories, and age.
